plugins.name: superpowers-enhance
plugins.description: Override layer for the superpowers skills. A PostToolUse hook injects a matching *-enhance skill right after its base skill is invoked: brainstorming asks its clarifying questions in AskUserQuestion rounds instead of one at a time, and plan execution (executing-plans, subagent-driven-development, using-git-worktrees) is locked to a dedicated branch + worktree with no fallback to the current checkout.
